P1.title: Pick duo: long-range payoff + hard hold
heroes: Vindicta (Assassinate 1s scope, Stake tether, Crow shred)
Grey Talon (charged arrow, Guided Owl, Spirit Snare)
questions: Does damage from the sniper break the partner's hold/sleep? Does the sniper's shot still land at full damage on a held/asleep/frozen target?
Is the hold long enough for scope/charge time plus cast delay?
Do the holds keep the target stationary or just unable to act?

P2.title: Brawler + sustain/zone partner
partners: Kelvin (Frost Grenade, Frozen Shelter, Arctic Beam)
questions: Does partner healing/shield stack with the brawler's own and how much does it scale with the partner's spirit?
Do partner slows/zones keep enemies inside the brawler's aura radius (8-9m)?
Which partner effects follow a diving brawler (range, duration vs dive time)?

P3.title: Spirit-resist shred and damage zones
heroes: Graves (Borrowed Decree stacking spirit-resist reduction, Grasping Hands wall)
Seven (Power Surge spirit shred, Storm Cloud)
questions: Do spirit-resist reductions from different sources stack additively or multiplicatively and apply to ALLY spirit damage?
Do the zones apply to damage dealt by allies, or only the caster's?
Timing: shred duration vs partner burst cooldown windows.

P4.title: Clump then AoE payoff
heroes: Lash (Death Slam lift+slam, up to 6 targets)
questions: How long are enemies actually kept inside the payoff's radius/fuse window by the clump ability?
Is the pulled/slammed position inside the payoff radius?
Do partner payoffs apply to enemies in the air/held?

P5.title: Mo & Krill Combo hold + payoff
heroes: Mo & Krill (Combo hold 4m range, Burrow, Sand Blast, Scorn)
partners: Bebop (Hyper Beam, Sticky Bomb, Exploding Uppercut, hook)
questions: Combo hold: does the target stay stationary/targetable for the full duration? can allies damage it? does the hold break?
How does Mo get within 4m (Burrow emerge, partner pull/hook)? Can Bebop's hook pull an enemy to Mo?
Hyper Beam/Sticky Bomb damage totals inside the Combo window, and DoT items (e.g. Alchemical Fire) on a held target.

P6.title: Ivy carry/tether with a partner
heroes: Ivy (Air Drop carries an ALLY up to 21s, Kudzu Connection tether, Stone Form, Entangling Thorns)
questions: While carried by Air Drop, which of the ally's abilities/items work (cast? channel? shoot)? Can the carried ally's ult be used (e.g. Singularity pull radius from the air)?
What does Kudzu Connection share (healing? damage? headshot heals?) and who gets it?
Does Air Drop carry enemies at all? Quote the file text.

P7.title: Calico resist shred with a melee partner
heroes: Calico (Gloom Bombs T2 melee resist reduction per bomb touch)
questions: Exact melee/bullet resist reduction values, stacking, duration; does it apply to allies' melee damage?
Which partners actually do meaningful melee damage in our existing builds?
